title: Inventory: Foss et al. 2007 (Nat Genet 39:1369) supplementary information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/foss2007/raw/`. The only supplementary item on the Nature article page
(https://www.nature.com/articles/ng.2007.22, fetched with a plain request and a cookie jar, saved as `../article.html`)
is the Supplementary Text and Figures PDF, downloaded from static-content.springer.com. Nature's PowerPoint copies of the
main figures are not supplementary data and were not downloaded. The paper is not in PubMed Central (E-utilities elink
pubmed_pmc returns no link), and the main text and Online Methods are paywalled. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.41588_2007_BFng200722_MOESM17_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Text and Figures (18 pages): Supplementary Figures 1-3, Supplementary Table 1 (page 4: the 6 peptides with local linkage: peptide, protein, linkage markers, LOD, marker distance from middle of gene), Supplementary Note (genome-wide linkage counts, hotspot overlap) and Supplementary Methods (LC-MS quantitation).

missing: No table of genome-wide peptide or transcript linkages: only the 6 local linkages are tabulated; the Supplementary Note gives counts.
No table of the 4 protein-regulation hotspots (main Figure 4 only).
No marker positions: markers are named (ORF-based or chromosome-arm segments), so the build cannot be checked directly.
No segregant count, detection threshold or FDR in the supplement (main text and Online Methods are paywalled).
